name: Gods Compassion
overview: Scripture reveals God as a compassionate and gracious Father who tenderly cares for those who fear Him, demonstrating mercy that never fails and longsuffering patience. His compassion moves Him to act on behalf of weary and scattered people, offering forgiveness and kindness through Christ. Believers are called to reflect this divine compassion by forgiving and showing tenderhearted kindness to one another, grounded in the mercy God has extended to them.
